scenarios.name: Inspect project information from the template chooser

scenario_steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
a project is active
a template is selected with its details displayed
the user chooses Projects in the chooser
a Projects dialog opens above the chooser
the dialog lists project names and locations
the active project is marked
the dialog displays a project settings tree
New, Browse, Save, Apply and Done controls are displayed
the user chooses Done without changing the project
the Projects dialog closes
the template chooser is displayed again
the selected template details remain displayed

scenarios.name: Inspect an inactive project without activating it

scenario_steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the Projects dialog lists an active project and another project
the active project is marked in the list
the user selects the other project with a single click
the other project row is highlighted
the settings tree displays information for the selected project
the active-project mark remains beside the original project
the user chooses Done
the Projects dialog closes
the chooser still displays the original active project

scenarios.name: Inspect and cancels the new single-user project wizard

scenario_steps.name: the Projects dialog is open in the MCAD Software
an existing project is active
the wizard fixture has no entries in either library list
the user chooses New
the new-project wizard opens on a project-type page
New Single User Project is selected
the Next and cancels controls are available
the user chooses Next
the wizard displays a project name, workspace folder and project file to be created
it provides a folder browsing control
the user chooses Next
the wizard displays a Select Libraries page
the page has All Projects and New Project lists with transfer controls
both library lists are empty
a provisional project entry is visible in the project list behind the wizard
the user chooses Cancel
the wizard closes and the Projects dialog is displayed
the provisional project entry is no longer listed
the original project remains marked active

scenarios.name: Navigate backward through the new-project wizard

scenario_steps.name: the new single-user project wizard is on its project-type page in the MCAD Software
the user chooses Next
the project-file page displays the project name and workspace folder
the user chooses Next
the Select Libraries page is displayed
the user chooses Back
the project-file page is displayed
its project name and workspace folder remain displayed
the user chooses Back
the project-type page is displayed
New Single User Project remains selected
Back and Finish are unavailable
the user chooses Cancel
the wizard closes and the Projects dialog is displayed

scenarios.name: Cancel browsing for a project workspace folder

scenario_steps.name: the new single-user project wizard is on its project-file page in the MCAD Software
a workspace folder and project file location are displayed
the user chooses the workspace folder browse control
a folder browser opens with a folder tree and a Folder field
it offers Make New Folder, OK and cancels
the user selects Documents in the folder tree
Documents is selected and its child folders are displayed
the Folder field displays Documents
the user chooses Cancel in the folder browser
the folder browser closes
the wizard still displays the previous workspace folder and project file location
the user cancels the project wizard
the Projects dialog is displayed

scenarios.name: Choose the workspace folder for a new project

scenario_steps.name: the new single-user project wizard is on its project-file page in the MCAD Software
the project has a displayed name
the user chooses the workspace folder browse control
the user selects the Documents folder
the user chooses OK in the folder browser
the wizard displays Documents as the workspace folder
the displayed project file location is inside Documents and uses the displayed project name
the user cancels the project wizard
the Projects dialog is displayed
the original project remains marked active

scenarios.name: Expand and collapse project settings with the keyboard

scenario_steps.name: the Projects dialog is open in the MCAD Software
an active project with Folder Options and Options groups is displayed
the user selects the collapsed Folder Options group
the user presses the Right Arrow key
the group expands to show folder entries including Templates, Design Data and Presets
the user presses the Left Arrow key
the Folder Options children are hidden
the user selects the collapsed Options group
the user presses the Right Arrow key
the group expands to show project options including old versions to keep and unique file names
the active project remains marked in the project list

scenarios.name: Expand library groups independently in the project tree

scenario_steps.name: the Projects dialog is open in the MCAD Software
the selected project has collapsed Appearance Libraries and Material Libraries groups with entries
the user selects Appearance Libraries and presses the Right Arrow key
the appearance library entries are visible beneath their group
the user selects Material Libraries and presses the Right Arrow key
the material library entries are visible beneath their group
the appearance library entries remain visible
the user presses the Left Arrow key
the material library entries are hidden
the appearance library entries remain visible
the active project remains marked in the project list
